summary: Royal Bank of Canada filed a Form 6-K updating its credit ratings disclosure. On May 12, 2026, Fitch Ratings upgraded the bank's legacy senior long-term debt rating to AA+ from AA, affirmed its short-term debt rating at F1+, and confirmed its long-term issuer default rating at AA-. This is a routine credit rating update by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are involved. The filing is a standard periodic report and does not warrant classification under any special-situations category.
